verdict.rationale: SerpApi offers dedicated vertical endpoints selected via the `engine` parameter. These include a Google News API scraping news.google.com, with topic tokens (e.g. Business, Technology) and country filters, and a Google Finance API for stock prices, movements and related news. Further verticals include Flights, Events, Shopping, Ads Transparency, Autocomplete and AI Mode. Missing for 10: no evidence of a dedicated images endpoint, the Finance Markets filter is now limited to `indexes`, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the vertical endpoints.
